data.content_ref: inline:{"analogy":null,"claim":"The search for distinguishing evidence within a single evaluation is ill-posed unless the evaluation includes controlled checklist-violation probes: items designed to trigger the checklist incorrectly, so that mere compliance is expected to err where genuine reliability should resist.","counterconditions":[{"case":"If the evaluation does not include such adversarial probes, no within-evidence distinguishes compliance from reliability.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the expert is also fooled by the same adversarial probes, resistance does not distinguish genuine reliability from expert-like competence.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"},{"case":"If the checklist is robust to the probes by construction, the probes are not adversarial and the test is uninformative.","checker_spec":null,"eval":"observation"}],"definitions":[],"derivation":[],"formalization_refs":[],"mechanism":"Mere compliance tracks the checklist, so on items where the checklist is deliberately misled by adversarial features, compliance yields the wrong answer. Genuine reliability, if it reflects the same competence as the expert, should resist the same perturbations the expert resists.","premises":[],"schema":"deepreason-reasoning-envelope-v1","scope":{"covers":[],"excludes":[]},"simulation_refs":[],"uncertainties":[]}
